title: Practice 7: либо, или … или, то … то, не то … не то

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Are those eggs boiled or raw?
exercises.ru: Это варёные яйца ___ сырые?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I don't know if I am going to go to Caen or to Troyes.
exercises.ru: Не знаю, поеду ли я в Кан ___ в Труа.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Do you speak English, French or German?

exercises.q: Is the mouse dead or alive?

exercises.q: No one shall be subjected to arbitrary arrest, detention or exile.

exercises.q: You can't reason with a fundamentalist, regardless of whether they're a Christian or an atheist.

exercises.q: Matter can exist as a solid, liquid, or gas.
